title: The lake and the city
text: Lake Pichola is an artificial lake whose history predates the founding of Udaipur. The name is associated with Picholi village. Later expansion under Udai Singh II helped shape the waterside setting familiar today. Its shoreline offers a way to understand the relationship between the city, its buildings and its water.

title: Islands on the water
text: Jag Niwas and Jag Mandir give Lake Pichola recognisable island landmarks. Their position changes how the water is seen from the shore: buildings become reference points across an open surface. A view from a public lakeside area can introduce this relationship without assuming that every island or palace is freely accessible.
